conservative_outcome_disclosure.reason: The frozen runner checks unresolved entry rows only inside summarize, after replay_online_portfolio. Fail closed: treat the computation as outcome-bearing even though no outcome or aggregate was persisted.

predecessor.static_stop_point_proof: The exact blocker text can only be raised by summarize after build_entries and replay_online_portfolio returned. evaluate_one_outcome either returns COMPLETED or raises a more specific exception, so at least one entry_status was UNRESOLVED_DATA_QUALITY.

static_temporal_finding.finding: The frozen 09:35 entry decision consumes entry-day CY-006 daily fields whose available_at and decision_at are 15:00, and CY-008 window validity binds those same full-day fields.

diagnostic_objective: Count, without identities or outcomes, the first mutually exclusive entry-evidence failure and independent static masks for the exact 251 V29R4 candidates, then stop before portfolio admission or any candidate outcome path.

authorized_input.action_cutoff: known_at and available_at must both be no later than entry 09:35; effective_date can only further bound an already-causal row and can never bypass that cutoff

required_output.independent_static_mask_counts: For every mask publish true, false, unknown and evaluated counts; true + false + unknown must equal administratively eligible candidates and evaluated must equal true + false.

predeclared_branch.if_any_after_observation_mask: Set causal_adapter_required=true. Build a new field-level execution adapter using only facts available no later than 09:35, without relabeling available_at.
predeclared_branch.if_any_raw_l_noncanonical: Set raw_l_tick_regeneration_required=true. Regenerate a new outcome-blind identity from the source gap row with source-provenanced raw_l_tick:int64; never round or clip L/coordinate_factor after the fact.
predeclared_branch.if_both_temporal_and_raw_l: Both repairs are mandatory in the same new outcome-blind rebuild; neither repair supersedes the other.
predeclared_branch.if_any_execution_evidence_failure: Set execution_evidence_rebuild_required=true and repair the specifically named cardinality, timestamp, minute-shape, validity, trade-state or snapshot evidence in a new registered asset.
predeclared_branch.if_any_price_or_limit_failure: Set price_limit_evidence_repair_required=true and regenerate canonical source ticks or limit geometry without rounding, clipping or relaxed tolerance.
predeclared_branch.if_any_daily_lineage_action_or_state_fai: Set upstream_lineage_repair_required=true and repair the upstream representation in a new registered asset.
predeclared_branch.if_base_entry_unresolved_zero: Set classifier_parity_failure=true; do not infer that the blocked performance arm was valid.

next_scientific_stage_after_causal_repai.cohort_rule: Regenerate an independent outcome-blind signal cohort; do not reuse either consumed V29R4 slot.
next_scientific_stage_after_causal_repai.frequency_feasibility_gate: At least 201 administratively eligible and causally executable 2018-2021 candidates are required before any Stage-B attempt because the target is strictly more than 50 accepted trades per development year.
next_scientific_stage_after_causal_repai.preferred_simple_expansion: Remove only the redundant rebound_from_post_gap_low_over_L >= 5 percent gate while retaining true gap/depth, recent-low recovery >=3 percent, prior-high reclaim, non-ST/tradable/not-limit-locked, amount <=2x prior-20 median, CAP25 industry round-robin, T+1, costs, target and horizon.
next_scientific_stage_after_causal_repai.optional_strict_sibling: Add only signal amount >= prior-20 median as the economically interpretable volume-demand confirmation, and test it only if the blind executable count is at least 201.
